messages:
Julia (support): FYI — customer tenant t-8a3f says monthly credits didn't show after their reset. They're in America/Los_Angeles and expected refill at 00:00 local. UI stayed at 0 until 2026-03-07 07:12:43 UTC. Repro steps & logs below.

Alex (eng): Can you paste tenant id, tz, and any request IDs? Exact observed times (UTC) help.

Julia (support): Tenant: t-8a3f
Timezone: America/Los_Angeles (PDT)
Observed refill: 2026-03-07 07:12:43 UTC
Customer had a long streaming session that hit 429s before reset. They also did a manual top-up (~+50k tokens) at 2026-03-07 00:05:12 PDT (2026-03-07 07:05:12 UTC). Logs: 

```
GET /v1/tenants/t-8a3f/credits -> {"available":0, "window_end":"2026-03-07T07:00:00Z"}
POST /v1/tenants/t-8a3f/topup -> 200 OK {"amount":50000}
GET /v1/tenants/t-8a3f/credits -> still {"available":0}
Background job refill processed at 2026-03-07T07:12:43Z -> {"available":150000}
```

Alex (eng): Thanks — initial hunch: race between the scheduled refill worker (UTC-aligned window) and the manual top-up/backfill job. If a top-up lands during the reset window we might not merge the ledger immediately and the UI cache shows 0 until backfill completes. Can you confirm if the customer refreshed the UI vs polled the API?

Julia (support): They polled the API a few times and saw 0 then a jump. Said they refreshed web console too — same result.

Sanjeev (billing): I checked the billing pipeline: top-up accepted at 2026-03-07T07:05:12Z but reconciliation didn't mark tenant "refreshed" until 2026-03-07T07:12:43Z. We had a backlog on the charge-processing queue (large upgrade batch overnight).

Alex (eng): Repro plan: 
1) Create test tenant in America/Los_Angeles
2) Drive tokens to 0 before their roll window
3) At local 00:00, issue a manual top-up within 2–10 minutes of reset
4) Poll /v1/tenants/:id/credits repeatedly and compare to ledger and UI cache
I'll try to reproduce tomorrow and check queue timings + cache TTLs.

Julia (support): Short-term mitigation for customer: advise scheduling top-ups >10 minutes after local reset or use the API to check `ledger_last_updated` before relying on the UI value. Offer a manual reconcile if they need it now.

Alex (eng): Also adding internal follow-ups: (a) expose a 'refill_pending' flag when a top-up is detected within the refill window so UI shows "pending", (b) consider prioritizing charge-processing queue for tenants with recent 0 state.

BillingBot: [automated] Reconciliation job run scheduled; expected completion ~2026-03-07T07:20:00Z :white_check_mark:

Julia (support): Customer confirms credits visible now. Closing loop. :slightly_smiling_face:
